title: BIASSCOPE: TOWARDS AUTOMATED DETECTION OF BIAS IN LLM-AS-A-JUDGE EVALUATION
reasoning: The paper includes a specific focus on evaluating and benchmarking LLM judges against a library of social and moral biases. It explicitly categorizes and evaluates biases such as 'Moral Licensing', 'Moral Disengagement', 'Moral Grandstanding', and 'Moral Bias' as part of its framework and benchmark (JudgeBench-Pro).
